subject: [PATCH 4/6] memcg: group the cold fields of struct mem_cgroup

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch groups the cold fields of struct mem_cgroup together to improve cache locality and reduce contention between hot and cold paths. The fields are moved from their current scattered locations in the struct to a single cache line group, which should improve performance by reducing false sharing. This change does not introduce any functional changes, only an optimization for better cache behavior.
